categories.main_business_segments: The company's primary business is the research, development, production, and sales of ion exchange and adsorption resins. These are functional polymer materials used for separation, purification, concentration, and enrichment purposes. The company operates through multiple subsidiaries including Ningbo Zhengguang, Ningbo Hanjiete,荆门 Zhengguang, and others, covering manufacturing and sales operations.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced synthesis and production technologies for ion exchange and adsorption resins, including polymerization processes, functional group reaction processes, and purification techniques. Key technologies include anion exchange resin production systems, chloromethyl ether production systems, solvent-free cation resin preparation, and specialized adsorption resin synthesis. The company uses DCS (Distributed Control Systems) for automated production control and advanced analytical equipment for quality assurance.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company serves diverse industries including power generation, petrochemicals, food and beverage, nuclear energy, semiconductors, pharmaceuticals, environmental protection, and metallurgy. Major customers include multinational corporations such as German BRITA, Japanese Mitsubishi Chemical, Swiss AQUIS, Chinese state-owned enterprises like China National Nuclear Corporation, China Petrochemical Corporation, and numerous listed companies. The company has served over 10,000 domestic and international customers.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with major facilities in Zhejiang Province (Ningbo and Hangzhou areas). It has established international presence through subsidiaries including Hanjiete Resin (Thailand) Co., Ltd. Products are exported to multiple countries including Germany, Switzerland, Russia, Italy, South Korea, United States, and African nations. The company maintains both domestic and international sales networks.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates in the midstream to downstream segments of the chemical supply chain. It sources raw materials (styrene, divinylbenzene, sulfuric acid, and other chemical precursors) from upstream petrochemical suppliers and sells finished ion exchange and adsorption resin products directly to industrial end-users and through distributors. The company also engages in outsourcing of certain basic resin production to manage capacity constraints.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes technological innovation and product development across multiple strategic areas: new energy applications (lithium extraction and battery recycling), semiconductor-grade ultra-pure water treatment, environmental protection (VOCs treatment and CO2 capture), organic acid production, biological pharmaceuticals, and import substitution of high-end products. The company invests approximately 5.21% of revenue in R&D and collaborates with universities including Huazhong University of Science and Technology and Zhejiang University of Technology.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue primarily through direct sales of ion exchange and adsorption resin products to industrial customers, supplemented by sales through distributors and trading partners. Revenue is recognized upon delivery of products and transfer of control to customers. The company also generates non-core revenue from financial investments and government subsidies. Sales are conducted on credit terms with established customers.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes with major multinational corporations including Dow Chemical, LANXESS (Germany), Purolite (UK), and Mitsubishi Chemical (Japan) in the global market. However, the company has established a leading position in China's domestic market through technological advancement and import substitution. The company holds competitive advantages in nuclear-grade resins, food-grade resins, and specialized high-end applications, with recognized certifications and standards-setting authority.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company is a mid-sized chemical manufacturer with 2024 revenue of approximately 571.8 million RMB, representing 8.67% growth from 2023. Net profit attributable to shareholders was 103.0 million RMB in 2024. Total assets reached 2.21 billion RMB at year-end 2024, with shareholders' equity of 1.89 billion RMB. The company demonstrates stable profitability with operating cash flow of 82.7 million RMB in 2024, though growth has moderated from peak levels in 2022.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company differentiates through superior product quality, comprehensive product portfolio covering 20+ series and 400+ specifications, and technical expertise in specialized applications. Key competitive advantages include mastery of nuclear-grade resin technology, food-grade resin production, and advanced purification techniques. The company emphasizes technical support, customer service, and customized solutions. The 'Zhengguang' brand is recognized as a Zhejiang Famous Brand with strong reputation for reliability and performance in demanding industrial applications.
